featured_reviews.name: urman parikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had Rajbhog Caterers for our daughter’s 5th birthday party, and the food was simply amazing! 😋
The creamy pasta, flavorful Mongolian rice, and the unique paneer kulcha burger were a huge hit with both kids and adults. 🍝🍚🍔

Thank you for making our celebration even more special with your delicious food and great service. Highly recommended! 👏🎉

featured_reviews.name: mili singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rajbhog Caterers is my go-to whenever I have guests at home! The food always looks home-cooked and tastes absolutely delicious. The best part is their beautiful presentation and the creative fusion they bring to each dish.
Quality, quantity, and value for money are all top-notch.
Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Nandish Sanghavi
featured_reviews.review_text: We had ordered Jain/Regular Starters & Combination Rice. The food was yummy & delicious,  all my friends relished & appreciated the taste. Peppy Paneer Kulcha Burger was scrumptious & favorite. I rate the taste & quality full on full 😊

featured_reviews.name: Renuka Bangard
featured_reviews.review_text: The Italian Cuisine from Alfredo Pasta to Enchiladas Pasta and Mayonnaise Veggies Sandwiches was not only flavourful but also a delight to foodies who love both presentation and exquisite taste..Thanks for the prompt service . Loved it to the last bite. Stay in abundance.❤️💖

So when I went next day to return it there was another short fellow with orange tika on forehead and he said he will charge for 2 days.
It’s not a question about money but these guys are thugs.
Once you pay heavy deposit on return they will find a way to cut double of you money.
Go at your own risk.
Pl like if this information is helpful.
Thank you 😊
